# ChartKit - AI Assistant Reference

> Lightweight React charting library. Zero dependencies, pure SVG, 17 themes.

## Installation
```bash
npm install @derpdaderp/chartkit
```

## Quick Examples

### Sparkline (responsive by default)
```tsx
import { Sparkline } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';
<Sparkline data={[10, 25, 15, 30, 22]} theme="midnight" />
```

### Line Chart with Auto Theme
```tsx
import { MonitorLine, useAutoTheme } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

const theme = useAutoTheme({ light: 'sunset', dark: 'neon' });

<MonitorLine
  data={data}
  dataKey="value"
  label="Metric"
  theme={theme}
  responsive
  height={200}
/>
```

### Bar Chart
```tsx
import { BarChart } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<BarChart
  data={[{ month: 'Jan', value: 100 }, { month: 'Feb', value: 150 }]}
  dataKey="value"
  categoryKey="month"
  theme="midnight"
/>
```

### KPI Card
```tsx
import { KpiCard } from '@derpdaderp/chartkit';

<KpiCard
  label="Revenue"
  value={125000}
  delta={12.5}
  data={sparklineData}
  theme="sunset"
  format={(v) => `$${(v/1000).toFixed(0)}K`}
/>
```

## All Components

### Charts
| Component | Description | Key Props |
|-----------|-------------|-----------|
| Sparkline | Inline trend line | `data`, `theme`, `height?`, `glow?`, `fill?` |
| MiniArea | Small area chart | `data`, `theme`, `height?`, `color?` |
| MonitorLine | Multi-series line chart | `data`, `series` or `dataKey`, `theme`, `responsive?`, `height?`, `glow?` |
| StackedArea | Stacked area chart | `data`, `series`, `theme`, `width?`, `height?` |
| BarChart | Grouped bar chart | `data`, `dataKey`, `categoryKey`, `theme` |
| DonutChart | Pie/donut chart | `data`, `dataKey`, `labelKey`, `theme` |
| ScatterChart | Scatter/bubble | `data`, `xKey`, `yKey`, `theme`, `sizeKey?` |
| ComboChart | Mixed chart types | `data`, `xKey`, `leftAxis`, `rightAxis?`, `theme` |
| Heatmap | Activity grid | `data`, `theme` |
| SpikeChart | Event spikes | `data`, `theme` |
| KpiCard | Metric card | `label`, `value`, `delta?`, `data`, `theme`, `format?` |
| ProgressRing | Circular progress | `value`, `theme`, `size?`, `showValue?` |
| GaugeChart | Semicircular gauge | `value`, `min?`, `max?`, `theme`, `ranges?` |

### Utilities
| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| Legend | Standalone legend |
| ResponsiveChart | Auto-sizing wrapper |

## Themes

### Dark (13)
midnight, emerald, mono, slate, arctic, orchid, obsidian, neon, mocha, owl, retro, copper, rose

### Light (4)
sunset, silver, pearl, latte

## Hooks

### useAutoTheme
Auto-switch themes based on dark/light mode:
```tsx
const theme = useAutoTheme({ light: 'sunset', dark: 'neon' });
```

### useContainerWidth
Get container width for responsive charts:
```tsx
const { ref, width } = useContainerWidth();
```

## Common Patterns

### Responsive Chart
```tsx
<MonitorLine data={data} dataKey="value" theme="midnight" responsive height={200} />
```

### Dark/Light Mode
```tsx
const theme = useAutoTheme({ light: 'sunset', dark: 'neon' });
<Sparkline data={data} theme={theme} />
```

### Custom Tooltip
```tsx
<MonitorLine
  data={data}
  series={series}
  theme="midnight"
  renderTooltip={({ data, series }) => (
    <div>{series[0].label}: {series[0].value}</div>
  )}
/>
```

### With Annotations
```tsx
<MonitorLine
  data={data}
  series={series}
  theme="midnight"
  annotations={[
    { type: 'line', axis: 'y', value: 80, label: 'Threshold' }
  ]}
/>
```
